demand.path: demand -> effective deficit -> acid burden -> drive -> RR / W / PaCO2 / pH

hr_latent.proof: HR reaches no output, delivery, deficit, D, lactate or burden (P2I-2AG, P2J-1)

map_set.proof: P2J-4 rows_equal (654 units): the baroreflex moves only the sympathetic drive; no deficit, burden or RR term reads it

tone_gain.path: g -> T -> output -> delivery -> deficit -> acid burden

design.candidate_rule: Predeclared before any clinical respiratory trajectory. Intrinsic RR: the faculty's 12 / 16 / 20, per patient. Drive gain: the exact-arrival solutions over both cases and the intrinsic support, spanned geometrically (1 to 4, ratio sqrt 2, five points), common to both cases. Acid production and clearance: the steady-state burden per unit of deficit B (k x tau) at the arrival anchor A0 / d0, three points, times three clearance constants 60 / 120 / 240 min; k = B / tau. Efficiency 1 (structural reference). 5 x 3 x 3 x 3 x 3 = 405 combinations, factorized: arrival compatibility reads (gain, intrinsic RR) analytically; the burden reads (B, tau) per deficit trajectory; RR, W, PaCO2 and pH are algebraic in the burden. No legacy RR, no outcome-chosen value.
decision_pack: arrival RR compatibility (per gain and intrinsic RR, +/- 3 provisional)
implied resting PaCO2 per intrinsic RR

faculty.acid_dynamics: dA/dt = production from the effective oxygen deficit - clearance; more deficit never less production, no deficit no new production, gradual clearance, the burden may fall while a deficit lasts, never below 0; D's no-repayment rule is not copied
faculty.acid_parameters: explicit exploratory deficit_to_acid_gain and acid_clearance_tau, independent of the debt and lactate parameters; a small range predeclared before clinical outcomes, from dimensional consistency, the authored arrival burden, the current deficit trajectories, synthetic probes and no instantaneous normalization; no legacy RR fitting, no final value
faculty.acid_state: a new common state, metabolic_acid_burden: a time-varying metabolic acid / bicarbonate-deficit burden, not lactate, not D, not pH; burden = max(0, HCO3_reference - HCO3), HCO3_reference 24 mEq/L COMMON_REFERENCE_PROVISIONAL, not FACULTY_APPROVED; the arrival burden from the bank's HCO3 (57m 17.3, 72f 19.8), never from lactate
faculty.arrival: 57m RR 26, 72f RR 24 against the HCO3-derived burden; the drive range is built before arrival compatibility is counted; common acid-to-drive physiology, patient-specific intrinsic RR, no residual offset; mismatch at +/- 3 breaths/min, ARRIVAL_RR_TOLERANCE_PROVISIONAL, not a measurement error; zero common candidates is a stop, never a wider tolerance
faculty.carried: MAP_set 80 / 90 / 100 and the baroreflex gain conditional on demand (1.0: 0.25, 0.5; 1.1: 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5) carried, not collapsed, not selected; nothing FACULTY_APPROVED
faculty.closed: P2K-1 accepted and closed: RR_STRUCTURE_NOT_READY - ACID_BASE_STATE_REQUIRED is a genuine structural blocker; RR is not calibrated numerically on the direct lactate -> RR proxy
faculty.d: D is oxygen-delivery debt and never drives RR directly; deficit -> acid burden -> drive is the metabolic path
faculty.drive: drive from the acid burden only; no new drivers for D, lactate, pressure or HR; explicit acid_to_respiratory_drive_gain, no value approved; hypoxaemic drive audited, numerically deferred
faculty.drive_rr_w: respiratory drive (central command), RR (observable frequency) and W (effective alveolar ventilation relative to metabolic need) are three quantities, never aliases; mechanics preserved, no support, no fatigue in the GI cases, so RR and W correlate, but the structure lets them diverge
faculty.early_stop: algebraic non-uniqueness, unstable acid / ventilation feedback, evaluation-order dependence, impossible pH / PaCO2 or an upstream regression stops the package; no parameter hides a structural problem
faculty.efficiency: effective ventilation rises with RR in the spontaneous GI cases, with an explicit ventilation_efficiency so a high RR does not guarantee a high W; 1 for the GI cases as a STRUCTURAL REFERENCE, below 1 only in synthetic probes; no mechanics / fatigue grid
faculty.hypoxaemia: HYPOXEMIC_DRIVE_DEFERRED: no new gain; the GI cases are not hypoxaemic; the architecture allows a later term
faculty.intrinsic_rr: intrinsic RR 12 / 16 / 20 per patient, EXPLORATORY, not FACULTY_APPROVED; the two patients may differ; no case-specific acid-drive gain; no value added after outcomes
faculty.lactate: once the acid burden is active, the lactate concentration drives no RR; lactate stays a biomarker; a guard proves lactate alone, with burden and ventilation fixed, leaves RR unchanged
faculty.lgn: L, G and N are not added as RR drivers for the GI cases: GENERALIZATION_PATH_RESERVED
faculty.paco2: algebraic from W, higher W lower PaCO2, anchored to each patient's authored arrival PaCO2 (57m 31, 72f 33) so minute 0 is exact by construction; no PaCO2 time constant in P2K-2
faculty.ph: pH from HCO3 and PaCO2 by the bicarbonate / CO2 relation, never a tuned state; arrival 57m 7.37 and 72f 7.40 within source rounding, the exact error reported, no offset
faculty.rr: RR from the patient-specific intrinsic RR plus the non-negative drive, continuous and monotone, smoothly saturating; no lactate or D term; no hard clip as the primary physiology
faculty.scope: shadow only: no runtime integration, GI or second-family migration, final RR / acid approval, hard RR envelope, consciousness recalibration, collapse activation, mechanical-ventilation calibration or legacy fitting
faculty.support: spontaneous breathing, room air except FiO2 where represented, no NIV or invasive ventilation: the mechanical override is not a GI blocker; no NIV / mode / PEEP in P2K-2: FUTURE_GENERALIZATION_REQUIREMENT; FiO2 acts through oxygenation and delivery
faculty.upstream: BloodState, output, pressure / tone, DO2 / effective deficit, D, lactate and HR / baroreflex are reused and must not change; only respiratory outputs may
faculty.w: W = effective alveolar ventilation relative to metabolic ventilatory need: 1 matches it, below 1 relative hypoventilation, above 1 relative hyperventilation; not the drive
faculty.w_leak: the old W use (W > 0 multiplying part of RR, W < 0 scaling it) is a SEMANTIC_LEAK retired in the candidate: drive -> RR, drive + efficiency -> W, W -> PaCO2, never W -> drive

design.identifiability_rule: Frozen. Arrival compatibility (+/- 3, provisional) is the only authored respiratory constraint besides the arrival gas: a quantity is WELL_CONSTRAINED when one value is compatible, PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED when some but not all are, NON_IDENTIFIABLE when every value is or the arrival does not read it; the arrival burden is exact from the authored HCO3. B and tau reach only trajectories with no authored later observation: NON_IDENTIFIABLE from authored data, their trajectory sensitivity reported. The implied resting PaCO2 is reported, never filtered. No best set.

lgn.G: C6 gas exchange: no RR or SpO2 term; a future family may couple it to PaO2 / SpO2 and a hypoxaemic drive
lgn.L: C5 lung water / mechanics: no RR term; a future respiratory family may lower efficiency or load the drive
lgn.N: C9 CNS depression: no RR term; a future family may scale the drive (depressants)

design.policy: Shadow only. The acid-base physiology is in the core and off by default; the candidate is the profile with its three gains declared. Candidates predeclared and exploratory; nothing selected or approved; no RR envelope filters anything (ANALYTIC_REJECTION and SIMULATION_REJECTION mark only impossible values: HCO3 or PaCO2 not positive). The P2J-3 region recomputed through P2J-4's machinery; legacy RR never read.
design.probe_rule: Synthetic, structural only, on the neutral probe arrival (no deficit) with a declared arrival gas (HCO3 20, PaCO2 36, intrinsic RR 16) and the probe profile (gain 2, B 19.4, tau 120, efficiency 1). A: burden 4 -> 8, oxygenation normal. B: lactate alone raised, burden fixed. C: D alone raised, burden fixed. D: 60 min with no deficit, lactate clearance slowed to 600 min: the burden clears, lactate stays high. E1: efficiency 0.5 in the core at a raised burden; E2: the core's functions with efficiency falling 1 -> 0.5 while the burden rises. F: CO2 production down (demand ratio 0.8), burden fixed. G: CO2 production up (1.25), burden fixed. H: pH from HCO3 and PaCO2 at fixed states. W channel: state W 0 -> +0.5 and -0.5 at a fixed burden. No number here is a candidate or a clinical value.
design.reconstruction_rule: Every unique (scenario, blood set, lactate-side point) of the carried P2J-3 region at its demand and tone gain, as P2K-1 rebuilt it (vascular_tone.rebuild and debt_and_lactate): the effective deficit, D and lactate per minute. The burden is integrated from the deficit with the core's own acid_burden_after_minute for each (B, tau); RR, W, PaCO2 and pH are the core's algebra of the burden at each (gain, intrinsic RR). Validated against full core runs with the candidate declared, where every upstream row also equals the run without it. The P2K-1 RR of the same trajectories, recomputed, equals the P2K-1 record (default-profile non-regression).

retired.d_rr: NO_DIRECT_PATH: D reaches no RR term; the deficit D integrates also produces the acid burden, an explicit intermediate
retired.lactate_rr: RETIRED_IN_CANDIDATE: no candidate RR term reads lactate (BIOMARKER_PROXY_REQUIRES_REFACTOR resolved for the candidate); the default profile keeps it only for the frozen records
retired.w_rr: RETIRED_IN_CANDIDATE: the candidate RR reads no W channel; W is derived from RR and efficiency and feeds PaCO2 only (SEMANTIC_LEAK removed)

semantics.acid_burden: aux.metabolic_acid_burden (mEq/L), a dynamic state: arrival = max(0, HCO3_reference - arrival HCO3); each minute A' = A + deficit_to_acid_gain x effective_deficit - A / acid_clearance_tau (derived.acid_burden_after_minute, integration._acid_burden); never below 0 (tau >= 1)
semantics.bicarbonate: HCO3 = arrival HCO3 - (A - arrival A) = HCO3_reference - A below the reference
semantics.clearance: first-order, always on: the burden falls whenever A / tau exceeds the production, also while a deficit lasts; no no-repayment rule
semantics.default: off by default: the three gains None leave every default run, the golden and every closed record unchanged; the candidate is the profile with the three gains declared
semantics.drive: respiratory_drive = acid_to_drive_gain x A (breaths/min-equivalent): the burden only
semantics.paco2: PaCO2 = PaCO2_rest / W, PaCO2_rest = arrival PaCO2 x the arrival W at the reference efficiency 1 (the model's arrival RR): exact at minute 0 when the arrival efficiency is the reference (the GI cases); a lower efficiency lowers W and raises PaCO2 above that anchor (review: a constant efficiency used on both sides cancelled); PaCO2_rest is implied by the anchoring, not a parameter
semantics.ph: pH = 6.1 + log10(HCO3 / (0.03 PaCO2)), the case bank's own constants (clinical_cases._gas)
semantics.production: the minute's effective oxygen deficit, max(0, demand - reserve x delivery) at the start-of-minute delivery and the minute's demand: the one D integrates; linear, so more deficit never produces less and no deficit produces nothing
semantics.rr: RR = intrinsic + S (1 - exp(-drive / S)), S = rr_drive_saturation (25, structural); rr_max a safety guard only; RR = 0 without a pulse
semantics.w: W = efficiency x (RR / intrinsic RR) / (demand / baseline demand): effective alveolar ventilation over the ventilation of the patient's eupnoea at the current CO2 production; 1 at the intrinsic RR with no drive and mechanics preserved. 'Need' is that eupnoeic ventilation: it is eucapnic only when the implied resting PaCO2 is (adversarial review)
semantics.w_channel: the W channel (C7) is read by no candidate term: RESERVED for future families; the default profile keeps the P2K-1 RR for the frozen records

support.fio2: Oxygen sets FiO2, which moves SpO2 and, through delivery, the deficit, D, lactate and now the acid burden; it touches no drive, RR or W directly
support.override: NOT_A_GI_BLOCKER: no GI scenario ventilates; FUTURE_GENERALIZATION_REQUIREMENT for respiratory families

design.verdict_rule: Frozen. READY when every criterion holds: the burden is an explicit state driving RR (probe A), lactate and D reach no candidate RR term (probes B, C, the W channel), drive, RR and W are distinct (E1, E2, F), PaCO2 and pH are coherent (F, G, H, the arrival reconstruction), the RR / W dissociation works (E1, E2), the trajectories are patient-like (for some predeclared (B, tau) the untreated burden never falls in any R1 trajectory of either case; in every R4 trajectory RR stays at least 1 breath/min above intrinsic 15 min after haemostasis and the haemostasis minute moves RR no more than another minute), the upstream rows are identical and the core reproduces the reconstruction, a bounded candidate surface exists (at least one arrival-compatible common candidate) and nothing is approved. Otherwise NOT_READY with the first failing criterion as the blocker.
